## The recordings

- **gd83-02-01.sbd.miller.21266.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 8 songs; 50 min; rated 2/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Single drummer on the kit sounds clear and crisp, with hi-hat, snare and bass drum distinct [2]

## Around the show

- Tracks are funky, rhythmic jams; track 3 has a little scat-singing, possibly by Mickey. Jerry uses a pedal giving a muted-trumpet tone [2]
- Track 5 features only drums, piano and lead guitar; track 6 has only drums, bass and rhythm guitar [2]
- A drum machine runs throughout, which explains the nonstop jams; it offended both drummers and led to the studio material being shelved [3]
- Reviewer finds the material unlike anything the band was playing live in this period [4]
